item.tib: gsas mkhar mchog lnga'i rtsa gsum yang snying bcud du dril ba'i sgrub pa las gsang ba'i 'ben zlog ti ka
item.coloph: ces mchog lnga'i rtsa gsum yang snying gi gsang ba 'ben zlog ti ka 'di yang sangs rgyas dus tshes hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin rten 'brel nyi ma rtse shar khri gdug gzi 'od rgyas pa'i ngos nas bstan 'dzin skyes mchog ri pa 'brug gsas kyi rnam rol tshul khrims blo gros kyi gzigs ngos su rang 'byung rdo yi sgrom bu kha rang dbye ru gyur nas las can bdag gis pha nor bu yi dbang skal du dngos grub lon pa 'di yang dad ldan bu slob 'ga' dang bka' 'bangs 'gru rigs g.yung drung rgya mtsho nas yang yang bskul ba la brten tshe dbang bla ma'i snying bu tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'breng g.yung drung thogs med rtsal lam lo paN sha ri dbu chen mi yi gzugs su bstan pa smon lam g.yung drung bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi skyabs gur du tshud cing zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i shel skyes g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dbang gi rgyal por 'bod pa des/ shar grol smin gling du dran pa'i phyag ris shog ser ngos nas dag par phab pa'o
